meta.name: The Clearing
meta.description: When a local girl goes missing, a woman is forced to face the demons from her traumatic childhood.

videos.title: The Season of Unfoldment
videos.overview: After Asha is kidnapped, her elder sister Amy teaches her the rules of Blackmarsh.

videos.title: Kindred
videos.overview: Blamed for Asha's bad behavior, Amy is forced to take LSD as part of her clearing for her sins.

videos.title: Suffer the Little Children
videos.overview: Police raid Blackmarsh to rescue the children. Wayne tells Freya their daughter might have run away.

videos.title: The Foundlings
videos.overview: Adrienne has been found in Paris while Freya sees Dr. Latham giving a talk on The Kindred.

videos.title: Maitreya
videos.overview: Believing she has powers to walk through time, Dr Latham helps Adrienne form The Kindred.

videos.title: The Pied Piper
videos.overview: Adrienne is extradited and Henrik is released from prison not revealing what happened to Asha.

videos.title: This Too Shall Pass
videos.overview: Freya warns Adrienne she'll have her arrested if she reforms The Kindred.

videos.title: Island
videos.overview: Searching for Billy, Freya finds Adrienne on a private island relaunching The Kindred.
